summary.en: A two-level title sits inside a ring of content cards orbiting it; the key line arrives out of a blur, a highlighter sweeps it and turns its letters dark, a kicker floats up.
summary.zh: 八张内容卡沿椭圆匀速公转，中间两级标题逐字解糊落定，荧光马克块横扫关键行、扫过处字反白，副行浮出。

fits: The first shot of an opening that says "there is a whole set of these": a library, templates, a feature matrix, case studies; one claim held up by real product pictures.
notFor: A single hero object; claims longer than one short line; light, sparse styles where eight cards read as clutter.

overlaps.note: a 3D ring that turns a step at a time with the front card named; orbit-title is a flat ellipse turning constantly behind a title
the highlighter that sweeps one word of a still title; orbit-title sweeps its key line the same way, with the letters inverting under it

intent.en: Hold up one claim with a whole set of real product pictures circling it: cards always entering and leaving say 'there is more', while the title stays fixed in the middle.
intent.zh: 用一整圈真实产品画面托住一句主张：卡片永远有进有出，暗示“还有更多”，标题稳稳钉在正中。

content.en: 6–10 product pictures (16:9 crops or the film's own cards, each with a static first frame), a lead line (en ≤ 40 chars, zh ≤ 14), a key line (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 9, one line) and an optional kicker (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 16).
content.zh: 6–10 张产品画面（16:9 切图或影片自己的卡，首帧要有静态骨架），一行引语（英文 ≤ 40 字符，中文 ≤ 14 字）、一行关键句（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 9，必须一行）和可选副行（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 16）。

fits.zh: 开场第一镜，说“这里有一整套东西”：素材库、模板、功能矩阵、案例集；用真实产品画面托住一句主张。

notFor.zh: 单个主角对象；超过一短行的主张；浅色稀疏的风格，八张卡会显得杂乱。

pairs.note: a 3D ring when cards must turn and be named one by one

en: Never tilt the cards with the orbit; they change place, not angle, or the ring becomes a roller coaster and the text tilts.
Keep the key line on one line; the highlighter and the letter inversion assume a single line box.
Add no second moving layer (particles, sweeps, breathing gradients) over the turning ring; two constant motions leave no hierarchy.
Each card's first frame must be a filled still; cards whose content draws in from nothing show as blanks while the ring opens.
zh: 卡不能随公转倾斜；只换位置不换角度，否则环变成过山车，卡内字也歪了。
关键句必须在一行内；马克块和反白都假设高亮词在同一行。
环上不要再叠第二个持续运动（粒子、扫光、渐变呼吸），否则读不出主次。
每张卡的首帧要有静态骨架；“从零画出来”的卡在环撑开期间是空白。

upstream.name: 环形卡阵标题开场
upstream.summary: 石墨暗场上八张 16:9 暗色内容卡按 45° 均布在 720×380 椭圆上匀速公转（卡身永不倾斜，纵深只由 sin θ 给出 ±12% 缩放、z 序与远处压暗失焦），环撑开期间卡内容冻结首帧、f24 之后八张一起开播；居中两级标题逐字解糊下沉落定，关键词到位那一刻荧光马克块自左横扫铺满、扫过处字反白为墨，mono 副行随后浮出；可选末段整行失焦淡出、环继续转着交棒下一镜
upstream.use: 开场第一镜 = 「这个产品有一整套东西」；素材库/模板库/功能矩阵/案例集的门面拍；需要用真实运动的产品画面托住一句主张，而不是把截图摆成静态九宫格
upstream.energy: 中（唯一的持续运动是匀速公转，全片只有马克块横扫一次冲击）
